distribution: restricted custom supplied sets; not the random-team generator distribution

trace.args: uint32[lo, hi, form]: 1 = random(hi), 2 = random(lo,hi), 3 = random(2**32); form 3 has hi=0

policies.identity: stable mon IDs; separate native command-roster permutation
policies.simultaneous: private replaceable commitments until all required sides submit
policies.token: local generation/request episode, not native rqid
policies.rejection: atomic state/RNG preservation and empty trace
policies.overflow: atomic pre-advance rollback, no partial events or fabricated outcome
policies.history_limit: explicit capacity diagnostic; no silent truncation
policies.reset: terminal-only; supplied validated initialization, increment local generation once

exclusions: more than three occupied mons per side
arbitrary species, abilities, items, moves, natures, IVs, EVs or boosts
sleep, freeze, confusion or ordinary poison infliction
weather, hazards, trapping, transformation, called moves and unsupported effects
training, GPU correctness, memory/throughput or speedup claims
